name: App API local CA (system trust, for enabled apps only)
purpose: lets the local PowOS capture proxy inspect HTTPS from apps the user has EXPLICITLY enabled, so their traffic can be learned into an appcap and classified for tracker-blocking. A Magisk module adds the PowOS-generated local CA to the system trust store. Per-app routing/allowlist means ONLY enabled apps' traffic is routed to the proxy; every other app's traffic passes untouched and is not intercepted.
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/rooted.sh app-ca (Magisk module) — INSTALLED ON-DEVICE by the on-device agent with the user present; not installed from the Mac
selinux: unchanged — this adds a CA to the trust store only; it does NOT set permissive or alter any policy
scope: interception applies ONLY to apps on the per-app allowlist; the CA being trusted does not by itself route or capture anything
status: NOT YET INSTALLED — manifest + uninstall are defined; on-device install + a one-time uninstall test are the on-device agent's step, user present

commands: echo 'reboot to drop the CA from the trust store'
remove.note: removing the Magisk module + reboot fully reverts the trust store; nothing else changes. Keep nothing.
